# Browser regression fixtures

Recorded provider responses for `scripts/verify-ui.mjs` and `scripts/verify-alerts.mjs`. The scripts serve them through a stub of the desktop bridge (`window.dipAnalyzer.invoke`), each under the exact request the app makes for it; nothing here reaches a runtime view.

- `finviz-losers-r1-2026-10-31.html` is the live `https://finviz.com/screener/stocks?v=111&o=change&r=1`, the Overview's first page (200, no redirect), retrieved on 2026-10-31 at 08:05 UTC with the app's browser headers: the 20 biggest losers of the 2026-10-30 session, `#1 / 5620 Total`. It is trimmed to the result count line and the grid; scripts, styles, style attributes, logo images and icons were removed and the kept markup is unchanged. The app's parser reads the same 20 rows, row numbers and total from it as from the full page. `verify-ui.mjs`'s forced-colours check also serves it as Discovery's page, which there only needs rows to select.
- `yahoo-chart-PTHS-1mo-2026-10-30.json` and `yahoo-chart-CETX-1mo-2026-10-30.json` are verbatim Yahoo v8 chart responses for two of those rows, recorded with curl at the app's URL (`range=1mo&interval=1d`) and headers on 2026-10-31 at 08:05 UTC. Both quotes are the 2026-10-30 close (`regularMarketTime` 20:00 UTC) and both closes sit at a one-month breakdown, with a bearish trend (EMA5 under EMA10, the price more than 1 % under EMA5) that turns true together with it; both score 15. `verify-alerts.mjs` sets the browser clock two minutes after that close, when the app judges the recorded quotes fresh, and six minutes after it, when it judges them stale; with Breakdown alerts off, it expects the bearish trend's alert instead.
- One chart is not a recording. No recorded chart sits at a fresh one-month closing high, and no row of the losers page can (each trades under its previous close), so to raise a breakout through a scan at the default settings `verify-alerts.mjs` serves PTHS's response above as the chart of LITE, the first name of the Overview's Photonics basket, with test-only closes written over the recorded ones: a 20.00 closing high 12 sessions before a last close and price of 20.60, at PTHS's 2026-10-30 quote time. It scores 50 (Hold), under the default Minimum score of 60. The basket's other charts are unavailable in that check.

The stock-page checks reuse `../yahoo-chart-AAPL-1mo-2026-10-30.json`, `../yahoo-chart-PLUG-1mo-2026-10-30.json` and `../finviz-quote-AAPL-2026-10-31.html`.
